svg.text: Decompose the simultaneous-move matrix by spatial independence
My move on one edge and theirs on the other affect disjoint tiles.
n zones with k moves each side: n · k² instead of kⁿ · kⁿ
This is the independent-subproblems idea from the CSP chapter, applied to a game
matrix rather than a constraint graph - the link between chapters 5 and 6.
Risk: by the endgame the board may be one connected blob. Measure the zone count first.
Independent subproblems, borrowed from constraint satisfaction.
